patch:
diff --git a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
index 1a493a9f..a68688f9 100644
--- a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 import dataclasses
 import inspect
+import functools
 from contextlib import AsyncExitStack, contextmanager
 from copy import copy, deepcopy
 from dataclasses import dataclass
@@ -190,10 +191,23 @@ def get_flat_params(dependant: Dependant) -> List[ModelField]:
     return path_params + query_params + header_params + cookie_params
 
 
+def get_call_globals(call: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(call)
+    if hasattr(unwrapped, "__globals__"):
+        return unwrapped.__globals__
+    if isinstance(unwrapped, functools.partial):
+        return get_call_globals(unwrapped.func)
+    if inspect.isclass(unwrapped):
+        if hasattr(unwrapped, "__init__"):
+            return get_call_globals(unwrapped.__init__)
+    if hasattr(unwrapped, "__call__") and not inspect.isroutine(unwrapped):
+        return get_call_globals(unwrapped.__call__)
+    return {}
+
+
 def get_typed_signature(call: Callable[..., Any]) -> inspect.Signature:
     signature = inspect.signature(call)
-    unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(call)
-    globalns = getattr(unwrapped, "__globals__", {})
+    globalns = get_call_globals(call)
     typed_params = [
         inspect.Parameter(
             name=param.name,
@@ -218,13 +232,12 @@ def get_typed_annotation(annotation: Any, globalns: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
 
 def get_typed_return_annotation(call: Callable[..., Any]) -> Any:
     signature = inspect.signature(call)
-    unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(call)
     annotation = signature.return_annotation
 
     if annotation is inspect.Signature.empty:
         return None
 
-    globalns = getattr(unwrapped, "__globals__", {})
+    globalns = get_call_globals(call)
     return get_typed_annotation(annotation, globalns)
